# GhostShell

> Eleven free, open-source projects for hardware you own: console managers for
> Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, 4 and 5, PSP and Switch, Blu-ray and DVD authoring,
> PS3 disc decryption, a local browser bridge for CLI agents, and a live
> stream recorder.

Site: https://ghostyshell.github.io/

## Projects

- Keepsake Atelier - https://ghostyshell.github.io/keepsake-atelier/ - rip, author,
  verify and burn discs with native tooling; AACS key recovery, UDF 2.50 images,
  BD-J menus, 1:1 clones, MCP server. macOS, Linux, Windows. MIT.
- GODsend 360 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/GODSend-360/ - Xbox 360 game manager
  for Aurora: Minerva Archive and Internet Archive browsing, pure-Go ISO to GOD,
  DLC, title updates, save backups and an RXEA asset editor over FTP.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PSP - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-psp/ - PSP memory stick manager
  over USB: game and homebrew library with cover art, ffmpeg media conversion,
  ISO and CSO images, saves and mods. Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PS3 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-ps3/ - manage a CFW or HEN
  PlayStation 3 over FTP: library with cover art, virtual DualShock pad, game and
  homebrew downloads, ISO and split conversions, loopback MCP server.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PS4 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-ps4/ - manage a GoldHEN PS4
  over FTP: installed library, packages served to the remote installer, a
  DualShock 4 over WebRTC, PKG conversion and save backup.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend PS5 - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-ps5/ - manage a jailbroken
  PS5: FTP with port fallback, library from /user/appmeta, elfldr payloads, a
  DualSense over the Ghostpad payload, downloads and conversions.
  Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- GODsend Switch - https://ghostyshell.github.io/godsend-switch/ - homebrew Switch
  workshop: MTP, Tinfoil and LAN installs, library with box art, sys-con virtual
  pad, NSP tools and an MCP server on loopback. Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT.
- Browser Bridge - https://ghostyshell.github.io/browser-bridge/ - drives your real
  Chromium profile from any CLI agent through an extension and a loopback daemon.
  TypeScript. MIT.
- PS3 Quick Disc Decryptor - https://ghostyshell.github.io/ps3-qdd-mac/ - native
  macOS app that decrypts Redump PS3 images for RPCS3, no dependencies.
  Swift. GPL-3.0.
- Stripchat Recorder - https://ghostyshell.github.io/stripchat-record/ - desktop
  recorder for Stripchat live rooms: reads the HLS playlist directly, decodes the
  segment obfuscation in-app, appends so a drop cannot corrupt the file. Rust and
  Tauri 2. MIT. 18+.
- Chaturbate Recorder - https://ghostyshell.github.io/chaturbate-record/ - the same
  recorder for Chaturbate: separate video and audio chunklists muxed into one MP4,
  session re-minting mid-recording, append-only writes. Rust and Tauri 2. MIT. 18+.

All projects are free, need no account, and have no subscription.
